text.tspan: Tuberculosis death rate, by age World
The estimated death rate from tuberculosis per 100,000 people in each age group.

tspan.tspan: Data includes tuberculosis deaths in HIV-negative people. Tuberculosis deaths among people with HIV are classified under HIV/AIDS
